svg.aria-label: The ghosttea frame path: from the PTY in the daemon, through a utility-process bridge, to one WebGPU worker
svg.title: The ghosttea frame path: from the PTY in the daemon, through a utility-process bridge, to one WebGPU worker
svg.desc: Three processes left to right. The daemon, ghosttead, written in Rust: PTY, VT state in libghostty-vt, native text shaping, and a TRF1 frame, which is a display list. A frame socket carries it to an Electron utility process, whose bridge forwards it. A MessagePort carries it to the renderer, where one worker decodes it and draws with WebGPU. Electron main forwards no frames and React draws no cells; PTY bytes stay in the daemon.
